- Adds `--file_write_strategy=remote` to keep file-write and template-expansion outputs in the remote and/or disk cache when building without the bytes. The default remains `local`. Includes read-only cache support, local fallback on upload failure, and restoration after cache eviction. ([#31402](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31402))
- Streams `DeterministicWriter` contents directly to disk-cache output streams and opens blobs only when the disk cache needs them. ([#31403](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/pull/31403))
- Updates Merkle-tree directory traversal and path-prefix comparison to avoid intermediate path allocations. ([074aeda5](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/074aeda55612cfa99a148dd398e16f0a167db50a))
- Preserves prefetching of inline files when skipping inputs already present locally. ([273ff671](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/273ff67171459d4241b1d640a0afe8b2155f9b7e))

The worker-input digest encoding from [1b4ae3ab](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/1b4ae3ab9945c9ab40767b38bb9986f26855e530) and byte-backed digest hashes from [f1bd110b](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/f1bd110bd602eef3a7b0529691f672c108d51a61) were already included and are retained.
